name: window.list
description: Enumerates top-level windows. Returns an array of {handle, title, pid, bounds} entries. Read-only.

visible_only.description: Filter to windows that are currently visible. Default true. When false, includes hidden and minimised windows.

pid.description: If supplied, restricts the listing to windows owned by this process id.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against window titles (e.g. `notepad` matches `Untitled - Notepad`). Omit to list all titles.

handle.description: Window handle, e.g. 'win:0x1A2B' on Windows or 'mac:42' on macOS.

x-implementations.name: enum_windows
x-implementations.description: Win32 `EnumWindows` callback to walk top-level windows. Per-window: `IsWindowVisible` (filter), `GetWindowTextW` (title), `GetWindowThreadProcessId` (pid), `GetWindowRect` (bounds).

windows-modern.description: EnumWindows + IsWindowVisible filter; GetWindowTextW for Unicode titles. Bounds via GetWindowRect with DPI virtualisation honoured.

windows-classic.description: EnumWindows; GetWindowTextA on NT 4 / 9x, GetWindowTextW on NT 5+. No DPI virtualisation. Pre-NT-5 returns ANSI titles transcoded to UTF-8 by the agent.
